name: FramJet
about:
FramJet is a Java Spring Boot based framework created to accelerate the development of scalable, maintainable, and production-ready applications. It was designed to reduce repetitive boilerplate work by providing a structured foundation, predefined architectural patterns, and reusable tooling that support rapid project setup and consistent implementation across systems.

The framework focuses on transforming abstract ideas and requirements into clear, well-defined project structures and intelligent, practical solutions. FramJet integrates best practices for backend architecture, modular design, configuration management, and system extensibility, enabling teams to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure concerns. It serves as a foundation for building complex systems efficiently while maintaining long-term flexibility and code quality.

name: BlastDOM
about:
BlastDOM is a JSON-driven UI framework created to enable the construction of dynamic, reactive user interfaces through declarative schema definitions rather than imperative code. It was designed to decouple UI structure, data binding, and event handling from any specific programming language, allowing teams to define entire application interfaces as portable JSON documents that can be rendered and executed across multiple runtime environments.

The framework focuses on transforming UI requirements into structured, language-agnostic schemas built from composable nodes, reactive values, and declarative actions. BlastDOM integrates a signal-based reactivity system, a scoped data resolution model, and a rich set of built-in node types covering elements, conditionals, loops, templates, and asynchronous state,  enabling teams to describe complex UI behavior without writing rendering logic. With official SDKs for TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, and PHP, it serves as a universal UI contract layer, allowing backend systems to generate, validate, and serve fully interactive interfaces while maintaining consistency and portability across platforms.
